note: All calls, people, companies and amounts are fictional. No real recordings, no real personal data, no voice cloning. Amounts are written as spoken words, per the Timbre docs. Each turn's text is both the TTS input and the STT reference.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Namaste, main Sunrise Finance se Priya baat kar rahi hoon. Kya meri baat Rohan ji se ho rahi hai?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Haan ji, main Rohan bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Aapki EMI ke barah hazaar paanch sau rupaye pandrah November ko due hain.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Is mahine thodi problem hai, kya main do hafte baad pay kar sakta hoon?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Bilkul, aapko aaj hi poora payment karna zaroori nahi hai. Main aapke liye ek payment plan bhej deti hoon.

critical_spans.text: aaj hi poora payment karna zaroori nahi hai

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Theek hai, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Dhanyavaad, aapka din shubh ho.

turns.text: ಇವತ್ತು ಸಂಜೆಯೊಳಗೆ ಹಣ ಬರದಿದ್ದರೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಹುಡುಗರು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಆಮೇಲೆ ಏನಾಗುತ್ತೆ ನೋಡಿ.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಹಾಗೆ ಮಾಡಬೇಡಿ.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆಫೀಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ನೀವು ಮೋಸ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೀರಿ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳುತ್ತೇವೆ.
